i.norm: Verifies that isNotIn normalizes reversed start/end arguments and that a negated range excluding ['"','i'] does not contain a negated range excluding only ['"','"']. When arguments to isNotIn are in reversed order ('i' > '"'), the constructor swaps them so that start <= end. Then, for two negated ranges, containment requires the argument range's excluded interval to be a superset of this range's excluded interval; since ['"','"'] is smaller than ['"','i'], contains() returns false.
Negated range that excludes only the double-quote character
Negated range created with reversed args ('i' > '"'); constructor normalizes to start='"', end='i'

notInDoubleQuoteToI excludes ['"','i'] while notInDoubleQuoteOnly excludes ['"','"']; the smaller excluded interval means containment fails
